notes: Independent finite-element reference for the thermal Boussinesq benchmark; this is not a PINN, not finite-difference and not interpolation of the stored labels.
No formal natural-convection solve is run on a login node by the implementing worker; execution is scheduled separately by Codex through SLURM.
Physical coefficients are frozen from paper/docs; never tune them against the test set or rescale old labels.

physics.domain: square [-1,1]^2 minus a centred regular polygon hole

boundary_conditions.walls_velocity: u = v = 0 on both the outer square and the inner polygon
boundary_conditions.temperature: T = 1 on the inner polygon, T = 0 on the outer square

physics.Ra_identity: Ra = rho^2 cp g_beta DeltaT L^3 / (mu kappa) with L=2, DeltaT=1

pressure.meaning: pressure enters only through its gradient
pressure.gauge: mass-penalty zero-mean: add eps*integral(p*q); eps must be reported with true constraint div(u)=-eps*p and sensitivity; not exact gauge
pressure.gauge_alternative: fixed reference DOF is allowed by the protocol but was replaced after an environment-specific BC issue; the mass penalty is an explicit gauge choice, not a physical force

sign_check.convention: y upward; buoyancy term +rho*g_beta*(T-T_ref) in the y-momentum equation
sign_check.source_evidence: paper/main.tex modelling assumptions; docs/P1_热场NS_PINN设计.md residual definitions; data boundary T=1 inner/T=0 outer; data velocity ~0 on all walls

mesh.type: independent polar triangle mesh: radial rays from the domain centre between the polygon and the outer square
mesh.record: node/element counts, actual h_max, boundary tags, area conservation, min triangle angle and edge ratios are written for every mesh

elements.verified_by: manufactured Stokes and advection-diffusion convergence; pressure nullspace; boundary probes

solver.stabilization: none in this first review implementation; if a real pilot shows unresolved oscillation/divergence, record it as a blocker instead of claiming convergence or tuning test-set coefficients

mesh.quality_note: threshold pre-registered for the independent polar probe mesh; production gmsh meshes must report their own quality and are not silently substituted

natural_convection.note: a finite field or a Stokes pass is NOT natural-convection acceptance; all of these must hold, and no threshold may be tuned on test labels
natural_convection.weak_residual_definition: variational residual vector assembled at solution, all velocity/T Dirichlet rows zeroed; block norms relative to velocity/temperature L2 scales
natural_convection.galerkin_residual_definition: assembly of full nonlinear residual, all velocity/Temperature Dirichlet rows zeroed; free absolute and free/raw relative

external_fem_packages.dolfinx: not installed in any known environment on 2026-10-22

runtime.parallel: CPU only; SLURM compute partition, no GPU
